theorem_export.recommended_next_honest_step: Prove the P2607 GF(2) physical-origin and invariance theorem before attempting to re-enable P2608 role-bearing L_total acceptance.

role_semantics_axioms.statement: A candidate role-bearing L_total term must have a typed term name, variable domain, and target layer.
The term must contribute through a variational action slot, not merely through narrative bookkeeping.
Every coefficient/operator appearing in the term must have a non-quarantined strict source predicate.
If the term is imported through the legacy-to-strict bridge, the bridge predicate must be non-quarantined and physically derived.
The term's physical role must be an explicit map from term variation to the claimed observable/structural effect.
The role must not silently discharge QW-2191, ToE, APD sourcehood, or unrelated legacy physical roles.

theorem_export.role_semantics_statement: A role-bearing L_total term is accepted only when it is a typed variational action term whose coefficients and operators are strictly sourced, whose legacy-to-strict bridge is non-quarantined when applicable, whose physical role is supplied by an explicit variation-to-effect map, and whose use does not silently discharge unrelated selector, APD, legacy-role, or ToE claims.
